name: Janavis
sum: Large ichthyornithine from the latest Cretaceous of Belgium, the youngest known non-modern bird.
holotype: A partial skeleton from Belgium (number in Benito et al. 2022).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Benito et al. 2022
